label: Best months
quote: you can only visit Kundol Lake during the summer months
source: Kids Encyclopedia (Kiddle) summary of Kundol Lake; weak source

label: Winter
value: Heavy snow can close the route; some trekkers have gone in December
quote: Trekkers continue heading to Kandol Lake in December

label: Hike from Laddu
value: About an hour and a half to the lake
quote: the glacial lake can be reached in about an hour and a half

label: Hike time, other reports
value: 3 to 4 hours from the river bridge, by one account
quote: 3 to 4 hours' trek from the river bridge to the Kandol Lake

label: The road
value: Jeep from Kalam to Utror about an hour; reports say jeeps now stop short of Utror
quote: a jeep from Kalam to Utror takes about an hour

label: Before you go
value: Start early, carry water and food, hire a guide and porters
quote: Hire a local guide and porters
